result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visible problems: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, truncated text on the third carousel card, and a partially clipped category chip on the right edge. These are content and layout issues rather than functional breakages.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant twice ('Green Bowl Poké' with identical image, 15–25 min, €0.90 delivery), which looks like a data/deduplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate carousel items by restaurant ID before rendering so each venue appears only once.

issues.description: The third carousel item's title is cut off mid-word ('Smash Bros Bu…') with no ellipsis, making it look clipped rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., text-overflow: ellipsis) or wrap the title to a second line within the card width.

issues.description: A category filter chip on the far right of the chip row is clipped at the screen edge with no visible label, which can look broken if horizontal scrolling isn't obvious.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial-peek styling to signal horizontal scrollability, and ensure chips aren't cut at awkward positions.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom ('–20%') is cut off with no visible restaurant name or details before the tab bar, leaving the promo badge without context in the visible viewport.
issues.suggestion: Verify the card renders its title and metadata below the image on scroll; consider overlaying key info (name/discount context) on the image so partially visible cards still convey meaning.
